title: Negative tunnel mining contract (L5)
description: Detection of negative routing edges from contradiction events. See ADR-040.

invariants.name: mining_window_24h
invariants.description: Default 24h window. Range [1, 168] (1 hour to 1 week).

invariants.name: min_contradictions_5
invariants.description: Below 5 contradictions in window, no tunnel mined (too few signals).
must: below threshold: no candidate tunnel produced

invariants.name: min_contradiction_rate_30pct
invariants.description: Pair must have >= 30% contradiction rate vs successful invocations to mine.
must: denominator includes BOTH successful and failed invocations

invariants.name: hard_veto_semantics
invariants.description: Negative tunnel for (from_cell, to_solver) prevents routing regardless of forward tunnel trust.
must: routing path checks negative tunnels FIRST
match -> skip route, no fallthrough to forward tunnel

invariants.name: provenance_required
invariants.description: Negative tunnel cites provenance_event_id of most recent contradiction event.
must: field is the most recent contradiction_event id in the mining window
matches ADR-038 TUN-002 invariant for forward tunnels

invariants.name: lifecycle_alignment
invariants.description: Same revalidation/archive lifecycle as forward tunnels (ADR-038 TUN-007). Stale negative tunnels auto-archive.
must: revalidation interval matches forward tunnel default 30 days
archive after 90 days stale (no contradiction events)
archived tunnels have active=false in YAML, not deleted
